text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.hatch:
A brooded egg hatches only when its owner (the
longest sitter) is online, in the same dimension and
within 16 blocks. Off: a player nearby gets the
hatchling if the owner is offline. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.trice:
A Triceratops charge against the trunk of a
natural tree shakes fruit, saplings and sticks
loose; the tree stays. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.shake:
Share of the natural leaves whose hand drops
fall per shake (at most 40 rolls). 0 to 1.
Default: 0.5.

Chance of an extra apple from oak and dark oak
per shake. 0 to 1. Default: 0.35.

Seconds a shaken tree rests; meanwhile it only
knocks dully. 60 to 3600. Default: 600.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.ramCo:
Seconds between two Triceratops charges (shown
in the jump bar). 1 to 30. Default: 3.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.stego:
Blocks the lowered Dino Plow tills side by side
behind a Stegosaurus. 1 to 3. Default: 3.

The lowered plow sows seeds from the rider's off
hand on the empty fields of its strip.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.callR:
Blocks around a Parasaurolophus in which its
crest call gathers farm animals. 8 to 48.
Default: 24.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.callS:
Seconds the called animals follow the
Parasaurolophus. 30 to 600. Default: 120.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.callM:
Animals one call gathers at most, the nearest

text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.callC:
Seconds between two calls (shown in the jump
bar; right after a call a second press

text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.rapto:

jei.simpledinos.info.egg_path: From fossil to dinosaur: brush a fossil block (found rarely underground in deserts, badlands and swamps) with a brush until an egg falls out. Place the egg and sit on it with an empty hand to brood it, then wait for it to hatch; the hatchling belongs to whoever sat longest and grows up into a rideable dinosaur.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.title: Simple Dinosaurs

text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.brush:

costs twice its length. 5 to 600. Default: 45.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.incub:
Seconds a player has to sit on the egg until it

text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.hatch:
Seconds from a brooded egg to the hatchling.
10 to 7200. Default: 600.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.growM:
Minutes a hatchling needs to grow up.
1 to 600. Default: 40.
text.autoconfig.simpledinos.option.trexB:
Damage of an adult T. rex bite before difficulty.
1 to 40. Default: 10.
simpledinos.guide.page.1.title: Simple Dinosaurs
simpledinos.guide.page.1: Brush a fossil block free for a dinosaur egg, sit on the egg to brood it, and raise a hatchling into a rideable T. rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Utahraptor or Parasaurolophus.
simpledinos.guide.page.2.title: Fossil block
simpledinos.guide.page.2: A very rare find in the underground of deserts, badlands and swamps. Mined with Silk Touch it stays a block; without it, it breaks into up to two bones and the find is lost. Brush it with the Vanilla brush:
simpledinos.guide.page.3.title: Fossil block
simpledinos.guide.page.3: after about a minute of brushing, a dinosaur egg falls out.
simpledinos.guide.page.4.title: Dinosaur eggs
simpledinos.guide.page.4: One egg per dinosaur: T. rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Utahraptor and Parasaurolophus. Place the egg, then sit on it with an empty hand (right click):
simpledinos.guide.page.5.title: Dinosaur eggs
simpledinos.guide.page.5: after 5 minutes of sitting it is brooded, after 10 more minutes it hatches into a hatchling that belongs to the player who sat longest.
simpledinos.guide.page.6.title: T. rex
simpledinos.guide.page.6: The combat mount: three-quarter life size, a core hitbox of 3.6 x 3.5 blocks (head and tail reach beyond it). It hatches as a tame hatchling at a quarter of its size and grows to full size in 40 minutes (setting growMinutes); meat speeds growth up.
simpledinos.guide.page.7.title: T. rex
simpledinos.guide.page.7: Only adults carry a rider, with a large saddle.
simpledinos.guide.page.8.title: Triceratops
simpledinos.guide.page.8: The tree shaker: a heavy quadruped mount that hatches tame like the T. rex. Hold the jump key to charge, release it to run forward; when its horns hit the trunk of a natural tree, apples, saplings and sticks fall and the tree stays.
simpledinos.guide.page.9.title: Triceratops
simpledinos.guide.page.10.title: Stegosaurus
simpledinos.guide.page.10: The plow animal: a slow, heavy quadruped mount that hatches tame like the T. rex and never jumps. It pulls the Dino Plow:
simpledinos.guide.page.11.title: Stegosaurus
simpledinos.guide.page.11: lowered with the jump key, it tills a strip three blocks wide behind its hips like a Vanilla hoe and sows seeds from the rider's off hand. It never fights.
simpledinos.guide.page.12.title: Parasaurolophus
simpledinos.guide.page.12: The lead animal: a quick quadruped mount that hatches tame like the T. rex and never jumps. With a saddle the jump key blows its crest call: farm animals within 24 blocks follow it for two minutes, also through water, and it swims with its rider.
simpledinos.guide.page.13.title: Parasaurolophus
simpledinos.guide.page.14.title: Utahraptor
simpledinos.guide.page.14: The climber: a quick, slim two-legged mount that hatches tame like the T. rex and jumps about 3 blocks high.
simpledinos.guide.page.15.title: Utahraptor
simpledinos.guide.page.15: With a saddle and a rider it climbs walls: just walk against a wall. The stamina lasts about 12 blocks, then it slides down slowly. It never fights.
simpledinos.guide.page.16.title: Large saddle and dinosaur armor
simpledinos.guide.page.16: The large saddle (a saddle, 4 leather and 4 iron ingots) fits only dinosaurs; one rider.
simpledinos.guide.page.17.title: Large saddle and dinosaur armor
simpledinos.guide.page.17: Each dinosaur has its own armor in leather, iron and diamond with the protection values of the Vanilla horse armor (3, 5, 11): T.
simpledinos.guide.page.18.title: Large saddle and dinosaur armor
simpledinos.guide.page.18: rex armor from 8 of the material around a bone block, Triceratops armor around a Triceratops eggshell, Stegosaurus armor around a Stegosaurus eggshell, Parasaurolophus armor around a Parasaurolophus
simpledinos.guide.page.19.title: Large saddle and dinosaur armor
simpledinos.guide.page.19: eggshell, Utahraptor armor around a Utahraptor eggshell.
simpledinos.guide.page.20.title: Commands
simpledinos.guide.page.20: /simpledinos config shows and changes every option of config/simpledinos-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpledinos.guide.page.21.title: Commands
simpledinos.guide.page.21: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Permission level 2.
simpledinos.guide.page.22.title: Settings
simpledinos.guide.page.22: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
